title: A Modulus Proof of Cannon’s Conjecture
summary: We prove that every hyperbolic group whose boundary is homeomorphic to the two-sphere admits a proper cocompact isometric action on hyperbolic three-space with finite kernel. This resolves Cannon's conjecture positively.

review.reason: Proves Cannon's conjecture on hyperbolic groups with two-sphere boundary acting on hyperbolic 3-space.
